name: Goodie Guild
summary: Goodie Guild is a social browser RPG where players complete jobs, manage energy, earn XP and reputation, collect items, unlock achievements, customize profiles, and interact with other players. The game combines RPG progression with social features, rankings, collectibles, quizzes, card games, and community-driven activities. Goodie Guild also supports Twitch-connected accounts, allowing players to bring their Twitch identity into the game and creating opportunities for streamer and viewer interaction.
